# TinymcePage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on this page that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `TinymceElements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.

## In the page

- **"File"**: menuitem. In `TinymceElements` as `FILE_BUTTON`: `click().file()`.
- **"Edit"**: menuitem. In `TinymceElements` as `EDIT_BUTTON`: `click().edit()`.
- **"View"**: menuitem. In `TinymceElements` as `VIEW_BUTTON`: `click().view()`.
- **"Format"**: menuitem. In `TinymceElements` as `FORMAT_BUTTON`: `click().format()`.
- **"Undo"**: button. In `TinymceElements` as `UNDO_BUTTON`: `click().undo()`.
- **"Redo"**: button. In `TinymceElements` as `REDO_BUTTON`: `click().redo()`.
- **"Formats" / "Paragraph"**: button. In `TinymceElements` as `FORMATS_BUTTON`: `click().formats()`.
- **"Bold"**: button. In `TinymceElements` as `BOLD_BUTTON`: `click().bold()`.
- **"Italic"**: button. In `TinymceElements` as `ITALIC_BUTTON`: `click().italic()`.
- **"Align left"**: button. In `TinymceElements` as `ALIGN_LEFT_BUTTON`: `click().alignLeft()`.
- **"Align center"**: button. In `TinymceElements` as `ALIGN_CENTER_BUTTON`: `click().alignCenter()`.
- **"Align right"**: button. In `TinymceElements` as `ALIGN_RIGHT_BUTTON`: `click().alignRight()`.
- **"Justify"**: button. In `TinymceElements` as `JUSTIFY_BUTTON`: `click().justify()`.
- **"Decrease indent"**: button. In `TinymceElements` as `DECREASE_INDENT_BUTTON`: `click().decreaseIndent()`.
- **"Increase indent"**: button. In `TinymceElements` as `INCREASE_INDENT_BUTTON`: `click().increaseIndent()`.
- **(no words: an icon)**: button. Fragile: it counts positions; check it against a saved page before relying on it.
